source_claim: AlphaEvolve says feedback-driven evolution can discover candidates substantially different from the initial candidate pool in both syntax and function
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests include runtime.history.initial_pool_divergence_report for seed-pool baseline records, generated candidate workspace hashes, exact seed workspace match counts, bounded primary-file text distance, changed component summaries, numeric metric L1 distance, and generic bounded evaluator-output signature distance in candidate-to-seed comparison records. It does not claim task-specific functional-distance artifacts, task-specific behavior or output distance metrics, substantially-different threshold policy, benchmark-level discovery-distance telemetry, cross-run discovery-distance tables, or a syntax-and-function joint claim gate.
